plugins.name: rpg-mcp
plugins.description: Turn Claude into a Game Master: a persistent, rules-aware RPG engine (SRD 5.2.1) that owns the truth of a campaign in a local database so it can run for years across conversations. Adds /rpg to start or continue a campaign.

plugins.name: mcp-email
plugins.description: Your mailbox as tools for Claude: read, search, triage, file and draft email over IMAP and SMTP, with several named accounts from one server. Sending and permanent deletion are off by default. Native binary for macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows; no Java needed.
